rationale_md: Portugal enters this Group K clash as overwhelming favorites, backed by a substantial 260-point Elo rating advantage over Congo DR that reflects the gulf in class between European champions and their African opponents. The model assigns Portugal better than 7-in-10 odds to claim all three points, with Congo DR's slim 9% win probability highlighting their underdog status. Portugal's attacking firepower and tournament pedigree should prove decisive against a Congolese side that will need a near-perfect performance to spring the upset.
